# i-CBMC Interrupt Benchmarks

Source: https://www.cprover.org/interrupts/

This directory is reserved for imported i-CBMC interrupt benchmark sources such
as Logger, Blink, Brake, and RcCore. Record the exact download URL, license, and
import date when adding files.

Do not edit imported source files in place. Add CBMC compatibility declarations
or harnesses as separate support files.
